arguments.name: difficulty

arguments.name: custom_creatures

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Full-text keyword search across all Pathfinder 2e content (spells, feats, items, creatures, etc.). Matches whole words, not prefixes, and returns at most 20 hits per content type. Use this when you don't know the exact type of what you're looking for; use advanced_search to filter by level, rank, traits, rarity, and other properties.

tools.name: advanced_search
tools.description: Filter Pathfinder 2e content of one type by properties: level or rank range, traits, rarity, spell tradition, action cost, item group, size, and partial name or description text. Use for questions like "rank 3 arcane fire spells", "level 5 rare creatures", or "level 1 reaction feats". For creature themes, search by traits: e.g. traits_any ["Air", "Beast"] for sky predators, ["Undead"] for a crypt, ["Aquatic", "Amphibious"] for a flooded ruin, ["Fungus", "Plant"] for an overgrown cave. Results list each entry's traits, and broad searches summarize the most common traits to help pick a theme. Searches official published sources only unless include_homebrew is true. Results are sorted by level/rank then name and paged with limit/offset.

description.description: Text that must appear in the description

traits.description: Trait names (e.g. "Fire", "Undead") or trait IDs; results must have ALL of them

traits_any.description: Trait names or IDs; results must have AT LEAST ONE of them (best for themes, e.g. ["Air", "Beast"])

traits_none.description: Trait names or IDs; results must have NONE of them (e.g. ["Human"] to exclude humans)

feat_type.description: Ability block kind when type is "feat" (default "feat")

include_homebrew.description: Also search homebrew and unpublished sources (default false)

content_sources.description: Restrict to these content source IDs (overrides include_homebrew)

tools.name: find_spell
tools.description: Look up one or more Pathfinder 2e spells by name or ID. Returns full spell details including casting time, range, targets, duration, and description.

name.description: Exact spell name (case-insensitive). On a miss, similar names are suggested; use advanced_search for partial matches.

id.description: Spell ID or array of IDs

traits.description: Filter by trait IDs (use find_feat or search_content to look up trait IDs)

content_sources.description: Limit results to specific content source IDs

name.description: Exact feat name (case-insensitive). On a miss, similar names are suggested; use advanced_search for partial matches.

id.description: Ability block ID or array of IDs

content_sources.description: Limit results to specific content source IDs

tools.name: find_item

name.description: Exact item name (case-insensitive). On a miss, similar names are suggested; use advanced_search for partial matches.

id.description: Item ID or array of IDs

name.description: Exact creature name (case-insensitive). On a miss, similar names are suggested; use advanced_search for partial matches.

id.description: Creature ID or array of IDs

content_sources.description: Limit results to specific content source IDs

tools.name: find_character
tools.description: Retrieve one or more player character sheets from Wanderer's Guide. Requires a pre-authorized character access grant — if this returns an authorization error, the character owner must authorize access via the Wanderer's Guide account settings.

id.description: Character ID or array of IDs

user_id.description: Filter by user UUID to retrieve all characters belonging to that user

campaign_id.description: Filter by campaign ID to retrieve all characters in that campaign. Defaults to WG_CAMPAIGN_ID env var if not provided.

tools.name: find_campaign
tools.description: Retrieve campaigns by ID, owner UUID, or join key. With no filters, returns the campaigns you own.

id.description: Campaign ID or array of IDs

user_id.description: Filter by user UUID to retrieve campaigns owned by that user

join_key.description: Look up a campaign by its join key

tools.name: find_encounter
tools.description: Retrieve encounters within a campaign, with an XP/difficulty breakdown. Set detailed to include full stat blocks of every creature.

id.description: Specific encounter ID

campaign_id.description: Filter by campaign ID. Defaults to WG_CAMPAIGN_ID env var if not provided.

detailed.description: Include full stat blocks for each distinct creature (default false)

tools.name: encounter_budget
tools.description: Calculate encounter XP and difficulty (GM Core Building Encounters) before creating it. With no creatures, returns the XP budgets for the party. Creatures can be given by level, database ID, or exact name, with elite/weak adjustments. Mark creatures that are present but not fighting (a social NPC) as non_combatant: the report then shows the combat XP that sets the difficulty separately from the total.

id.description: Creature ID

name.description: Exact creature name, or a label when level is given

non_combatant.description: Present but not fighting (e.g. a social NPC): excluded from the combat XP and difficulty

tools.name: creature_benchmarks
tools.description: Typical stats for creatures of a level (AC, HP, Perception, saves, strike attack and damage, spell DC, best skill) as low / moderate / high / extreme bands, measured from the official creatures in the database. Use it to set balanced numbers for a custom creature.

tools.name: preview_custom_creature
tools.description: Build a custom creature without saving it and show the stat block Wanderer's Guide will compute, how its stats compare with official creatures of its level, and warnings (unknown spells, traits, items). Use it to check a custom enemy before passing the same object in create_encounter.custom_enemies.

base_creature_id.description: Start from this database creature and apply the other fields as overrides

base_creature_name.description: Exact name of the base creature (alternative to base_creature_id)

traits.description: Trait names (or IDs). With a base creature, these REPLACE its traits; use add_traits to keep them

add_traits.description: With a base creature: traits added to the base creature's traits

notes.description: Conditional notes, e.g. {"saves": ["+1 status to all saves vs. magic"], "hp": ["negative healing"]}

attack.description: Attack modifier for the first Strike, e.g. 15

damage.description: e.g. "2d8+6 slashing" or "1d10+4 piercing plus 1d6 fire"

spellcasting.description: Spellcasting entries. Spells are looked up by exact name in the database.

rank.description: Rank cast at (cantrips: their heightened rank)

slots.description: Spontaneous casters: slots per rank (default 3 per rank). Prepared slots come from the spell list.

items.description: Existing items carried (looked up by exact name), e.g. [{"name": "Healing Potion (Minor)", "quantity": 2}]

abilities.description: Special abilities. Standard creature abilities (Reactive Strike, Improved Grab, Knockdown, Push, Fast Healing 5, Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Fire), Telepathy 100 feet, Void Healing, Shield Block, Throw Rock…) only need {"name": "...", "existing": true}. Otherwise copy one from a database creature (from_creature), copy a database action/feat (existing: true), or write the rules text.

existing.description: A standard creature ability (e.g. "Reactive Strike"), or a database action/feat with this exact name

from_creature.description: Copy the ability with this name from a database creature (exact name or ID). Legacy names match (Attack of Opportunity = Reactive Strike)

description.description: Rules text, e.g. "**Effect** ..." with saves as "DC 22 Reflex"

replace_strikes.description: With a base creature: drop its strikes instead of adding to them

replace_spellcasting.description: With a base creature: drop its spells instead of adding to them

replace_abilities.description: With a base creature: drop its abilities instead of adding to them

remove_abilities.description: With a base creature: ability names to remove

remove_traits.description: With a base creature (base_creature_id or base_creature_name): trait names to remove

inputSchema.description: A custom creature. Either a full stat block (name, level, perception, ac, hp, saves required), or base_creature_id/base_creature_name plus only the fields to change. All numbers are final totals as printed in a stat block. Stay close to GM Core "Building Creatures" values for the level; compare with find_creature results.

tools.name: create_encounter
tools.description: Create an encounter with database creatures and/or custom creatures, and report its XP and difficulty. Use find_creature / advanced_search for database IDs. Custom creatures are written as a normal PF2e stat block (spells, items, and traits by name) or as an existing creature plus overrides (base_creature_id). Use dry_run to check the XP budget and custom stat blocks before saving; combine it with export_file to produce an importable JSON file.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to create the encounter in. Defaults to WG_CAMPAIGN_ID env var if not provided.

description.description: Encounter description / GM notes (setup, tactics, XP budget)

party_level.description: Average party level (needed for the XP report)

party_size.description: Number of players in the party (default 4)

id.description: Creature ID (from find_creature or advanced_search)

adjustment.description: GM Core elite (+2 stats, +1 level, more HP) or weak (-2 stats, -1 level, less HP) adjustment

non_combatant.description: Present but not fighting (e.g. a social NPC): shown, but excluded from the combat XP and difficulty

custom_enemies.description: Custom creatures. Each item uses the same shape as preview_custom_creature, plus an optional count and non_combatant.

tools.name: remove_combatants
tools.description: Remove combatants from an existing encounter by position (as numbered by find_encounter) or by exact name (removes every copy), then report the new XP total.

tools.name: repair_encounter
tools.description: Fix an encounter that does not render on the Wanderer's Guide website: rebuilds incomplete custom creatures into the complete creature format and removes trait IDs the site cannot load. Other combatants are left unchanged.

tools.name: update_encounter
tools.description: Update metadata on an existing encounter (name, description, party info, icon, color). Use add_combatants / remove_combatants to change creatures.

id.description: Encounter ID to update

party_level.description: Party level for XP budget display

campaign_id.description: Move encounter to a different campaign. Defaults to WG_CAMPAIGN_ID env var if not provided.

tools.name: delete_encounter
tools.description: Permanently delete an encounter by ID.

id.description: Encounter ID to delete
